title: Input-head movement bound
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $K$ work tapes, let $b$ be a choice bit, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input. After one step under $b$, the input-head position is at most one greater than its previous position.
